question: Where is the nearest fast food restaurant along the route from Ganyard Hill Farms, Durham, NC to Johnston County Rugby Park, Wilsons Mills, NC?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Ganyard Hill Farms%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Johnston County Rugby Park%' LIMIT 1 ), route_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(ST_Centroid(sp.geometry), ST_Centroid(ep.geometry))::geography, 1000)::geometry AS geom FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, start_point sp_geom WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM route_corridor)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp_geom.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
